messages:
sasha: Quick follow-up to the RFC I posted last week — TL;DR: propose a small, explicit "capability gate" plugin surface in the runtime to extract things like prefix/KV caching, telemetry enrichment, and model-routing heuristics into pluggable modules. Goal is incremental modularization without a big cutover. Thoughts?

marta: +1 to the idea of a formal boundary. main worry is per-token overhead. if every token goes through an interface call we could regress latency. can we keep a fast inline path and only hit the plugin when a capability is enabled? :thinking_face: 

sam_g: agree with marta. ops-wise we need a safe rollout plan (feature flag + canary + fallback). also we should define a minimal interface so implementations can be inlined/optimized later. e.g.:
```
interface Capability {
  name: string
  onRequest(ctx, req) -> maybe Response
  onToken(ctx, token) -> token
}
```
If onToken is hot, it must be inlined by the JIT or compiled path.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: FYI — canary window templates available at https://internal/redwood/rollouts (no action).

sasha: Agreed on fast-path. My proposal:
1) define very small interfaces (pre-token, token-hint, post).
2) runtime ships a NOOP default impl (zero overhead).
3) implement prefix-cache as first real plugin behind a feature flag. will measure p50/p95 delta.
4) if perf is acceptable, move KV cache next.
5) add plugin lifecycle hooks for metrics and safe fallback.
This keeps backward compatibility and gives us an extraction story.

marta: Sounds reasonable. A couple of additional constraints: plugins must not hold tenancy-sensitive keys in process memory (for Private customers). we need KMS/HSM patterns for any secret material and clear ownership of audit events. also define a schema for plugin telemetry (namespaced metrics).

sam_g: For rollout metrics, suggest we capture: p50 token latency, token CPU, error rate, and quality regression (sampled outputs + eval set). We should add a small benchmark harness; e.g.:
```
# run: bench a small seq-len sweep
tools/bench/run --rps 500 --seq 256,512,1024 --samples 1000 --collect token_latency,cpu
```
Also we can wire synthetic QPS tests to our performance lab before enabling on prod.

sasha: Thanks — will draft a short follow-up RFC with the interface sketch, migration steps, and the benchmark plan. plan to put prefix-cache POC in a feature branch and flag it behind canary. target: POC + bench results in 3 weeks.

marta: Can you also include a security checklist for Private deployments (KMS integration, no-secret persistence, audit events)? I can help.

sam_g: happy to own the bench harness and perf dashboards. I'll add a template to the runbook.

sasha: Perfect — action items: sasha: draft RFC + POC; marta: security checklist; sam_g: bench harness + dashboard. ops-bot: we'll call the canary template when ready. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
